headline: 004D4DF0 does not walk scene entities. Both the Registration and the Instantiate pass are the already-reconstructed 0046DF00 BSP_SceneFile_Read, called twice with different flags; 004D4DF0 supplies the frame around them. Before pass 2 it opens the '2_' file block the mission_scene_load header says does not exist, sets four colour-remap textures on the render-resources singleton from record strings, preloads the record's effect list and the PlaneRumble effect, loads the scene's .nav AvoidZone file, and may force game mode 9 from a .ema probe. Between the passes it drains the class census pass 2 leaves in the global array at 00F8A09C into resolved 'Class_<name>' VFS preload aliases, which is why the two passes are separate calls. After pass 3 it creates the MultiScore entity in a network session and scatters procedural clouds.

open_questions: Who reads [00E188A8]+19D0h and +19D1h, the two bytes 004D4E1E clears first.
The .scn keys that write record+C24h..CB0h: the header pass of 0046DF00 was not opened, so every scene-record offset in this packet is a consumer-side read (checklist rule 4).
The 28h-byte AvoidZone element layout and its deserialiser 004239E0.
The constant at 00D7A258 added to the cloud weight total, and the epsilon at 00CE3820.
Neither .nav nor .ema exists loose in the installation, so both extensions rest on the literals at 00CE7900 and 00CE7838 alone.

What the Instantiate pass needs from unreconstructed subsystems: 0046D930 entity creation, the class table 004F2800, the render-resource alias list at 010904E4, the model and VFS package readers, and the world node [game+19CCh]. None of those are in this packet.
